capabilities.name: Save to Skyreader
capabilities.description: Save an article to your Skyreader reading list (read-it-later). Accepts any web URL. Not for following a source over time; use subscribe for that.

capabilities.name: Subscribe to feed in Skyreader
capabilities.description: Subscribe to an RSS/Atom feed by URL so new items appear in your Skyreader reading list. For following an atproto account or publication, this maps to the account-follow capability instead.

capabilities.name: Follow in Skyreader
capabilities.description: Follow an atproto account or standard.site publication so its new posts appear in Skyreader. Requires Atmospheric sync to be enabled on the account.

capabilities.name: Share to Skyreader linkblog
capabilities.description: Share a link to your public linkblog with an optional note. The post appears in your portable standard.site linkblog, visible across the Atmosphere.
